vo: Button batteries? Not just a toy rule.
My broker asks about my remote's battery.
Part twelve sixty-three covers consumer products containing button or coin batteries.
Even if the batteries are sold separately.
Not sure which rules apply? Free C P S C finder. No account needed.
caps: Say I'm a seller. A TV remote with a coin battery.
Which rule covers the button battery?
Performance and label rules for products with them.
Products designed to use them count too.
